user.title: Notifier Configuration
user.description: The "Home occupied" sensor is created automatically. Choose its name and the proximity threshold.

menu.title: Notifier Setup Menu
menu.description: Add people and always-home devices to your Notifier configuration.

add_person.title: Add Person
add_person.description: Enter the person's details and notification service.

add_device.title: Add Always-Home Device
add_device.description: Add fixed devices like wall tablets or iPads.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only a single configuration of Notifier is allowed.

init.title: Notifier Options
init.description: Select an action to modify your Notifier settings.

data.occupancy_persons: Persons counted by the "Home occupied" sensor

manage_persons.title: Manage Persons
manage_persons.description: Select a person and choose whether to edit or delete.

manage_devices.title: Manage Devices
manage_devices.description: Select a device and choose whether to edit or delete.

manage_monitors.title: Manage consumption monitors
manage_monitors.description: Select a monitor and choose to edit or delete it.

data.threshold: Threshold (in the sensor's unit, per window)

monitor_habit.title: Habit rule
monitor_habit.description: Once a day, at this time, the last 24 h are compared with the same 24 h on previous days.

send.name: Send notification
send.description: Sends a smart notification via Notifier.

action.name: Target
action.description: Target: send_to_all, send_to_present, send_to_absent, send_to_nearest, send_when_present, or send_to_NAME (type the person name).

tag.name: Tag
tag.description: Unique tag to group, replace or discard the notification.

timeout.name: Timeout
timeout.description: Seconds after which the notification is dismissed automatically.

image_url.name: Image URL
image_url.description: URL of an image to embed.

click_url.name: Click URL
click_url.description: URL or dashboard view opened on click.

color.name: Color
color.description: Color name or hex string, e.g. red or #ff6e07.

persistent.name: Persistent
persistent.description: Also create a persistent notification in Home Assistant.

siri_shortcut_name.name: Siri shortcut name
siri_shortcut_name.description: Siri shortcut to run on click.

callback.name: Action buttons
callback.description: List of action buttons (YAML). Each button has a title and an event name.

until.name: Auto-discard conditions
until.description: Conditions that discard the notification automatically (YAML). Each has an entity_id and a new_state.

discard.name: Discard notification
discard.description: Dismisses all notifications with a given tag.

tag.name: Tag
tag.description: Tag of the notifications to dismiss.
